fr_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI doute que les Etats acceptent vraiment des règles qui seraient l'œuvre de la doctrine et non de leur propre volonté ou de leur coutume.
en_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI doubted whether States would really accept rules which would be the result of the doctrine rather than of their own will, or of their usages.
